newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador top court names Central Bank head in probe.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador top court names Central Bank head in probe.

text.p: Ecuador's Supreme Court said Friday it had formally notified Central Bank General Manager Augusto de la Torre that he was being investigated in connection with an alleged irregular loan.

The court issued a ruling saying de la Torre was aware that Banco Continental was in dire financial straits at the time the Central Bank extended the private Ecuadorean bank a $150 million loan in 1995.
"Indications of responsibility are presumed and he is being formally notified and his testimony will be taken in the near future," the court said.

The subordinate loan was extended to help Banco Continental overcome a liquidity crisis. But it was later found that the bank was artificially inflating its own capital, prompting the Central Bank and the Monetary Board to assume full control of the institution and remove its board.
The court said it presumed de la Torre was aware of the irregularities at Banco Continental at the time the loan was extended.
De la Torre has played a key role in implementing President Abdala Bucaram's new economic plan.
